svg.title: Diarrhea decision chart: acute diarrhea (under 4 weeks, usually infectious) split by blood and fever into non-inflammatory watery, inflammatory bloody and C. difficile; chronic diarrhea (over 4 weeks) split by blood (IBD) and the stool osmotic gap into celiac disease, other malabsorption and secretory causes; each column gives presentation, investigations and management

svg.text: Diarrhea (> 3 a day or > 200 g a day): ACUTE (< 4 weeks) or CHRONIC (> 4 weeks)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ask: onset · blood · how often, day and night · oil droplets (steatorrhea) · travel, antibiotics, hospital, sick contacts, food and

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: small bowel: LARGE volume, not urgent, infrequent · colon: SMALL volume, URGENT, frequent

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ACUTE: usually INFECTIOUS · is there BLOOD + FEVER?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: every one: ORAL REHYDRATION first (balanced electrolyte solution) · most need NO antibiotics

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ADMIT if severe systemic signs, can't keep up by mouth, infant, elderly or immunocompromised

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: complete blood count, electrolytes, urea, creatinine · blood cultures if febrile · abdominal X-ray if severe

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: CHRONIC: usually NOT infectious · is it BLOODY?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: BLOODY → inflammatory bowel disease (IBD): see the INFLAMMATORY

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: rapid transit (irritable bowel syndrome) · microscopic colitis
